name: Until Zombie Down
detailed_description:
Background story
After the leak incident, there were still a large number of zombies trapped in anarchic areas in some parts of the world. As a startup company, our goal is to regularly eliminate mutated organisms in various regions, assist in protecting people in various places, and also undertake commissions from some clients to achieve additional goals and earn rewards. Survive, achieve your goals, escape smoothly, and have another drink!
Additional contract
Due to the overall chaotic situation, our business is getting better and more stable customer sources are also increasing. Please be aware that the commissions of those mysterious clients may be lucrative but may contain hidden secrets.
Get ready
Before setting off, you can have a drink on the sofa of "The Shore" store to warm up, buy some interesting stuffs, or see if there are any new items.
Diverse environment
Pay attention to the season and weather forecast before departure to avoid falling into natural traps unique to some places. Late at night is often more dangerous than during the day. If it is too dark at night, buying disposable lighting balls is also a good choice.
Mobile Store
During the operation, commercial drones will appear regularly to provide you with products. There are many good treasures, so choose the appropriate items based on your characteristics to strengthen your system.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1060 or better

content_descriptors.notes:
There are scenes of a large amount of plasma and killing zombies or other creatures.
Users can turn on the green mode in the options to block bloody and uncomfortable content.
There are medical props that do not exist in reality.
